model.name: LCKR Basic T-Shirt - Men's
model.description:
Claim basics as your own in the LCKR Mosswood Basic T-Shirt. Crafted to be the foundation of your style, this basic T-shirt embraces a minimalist approach while offering limitless versatility. Available in the comfiest regular fit and finished with ribbed trim at the neck, the LCKR Mosswood Basic T-Shirt keeps you ready for stylish weekdays and laid-back weekends.

  • Cotton jersey fabric offers a soft and cozy feel.
  • 100% cotton. Imported.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx: If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit., | If you don't have a tape measure, you can use a piece of string and measure it with a ruler.
